title: Welcome Back, Alice
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Childhood friends Yohei, Yui and Kei reunite in high school, but Kei returns with long hair and a girls' uniform, saying they are no longer a boy without claiming to be a girl. Kei's sexual forwardness unsettles a love triangle in which Yui loves Kei and Yohei loves Yui. Creator Shuzo Oshimi frames the seven volumes as a deconstruction of male sexuality and adolescent desire, and Yohei's own gender identity later comes into question.
life_message: It holds up freedom from imposed gender and sexual norms, with all the confusion and frustration that freedom brings.
